quizDraft.title: Use border-box site-wide
quizDraft.prompt:
## CSS task

The stylesheet now uses borders and `padding` in several places, which can make declared dimensions harder to reason about. Border-box sizing makes `width` calculations include `padding` and borders, giving the whole site a more predictable sizing model. Keep the full cumulative stylesheet and add `*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }`. The preview may change only subtly now, but later `width` constraints should behave more predictably across elements.

### File to edit

`styles.css`

### Check your work

Keep the site's existing cumulative work, make the requested change, then compare the **Preview** with the **Expected result** before moving on.
quizDraft.hint: Apply the sizing model consistently to elements and their pseudo-elements.

help.concept: Border-box sizing makes `width` calculations include `padding` and borders, giving the whole site a more predictable sizing model.
help.hint_1: Apply the sizing model consistently to elements and their pseudo-elements.
help.hint_2: The preview may change only subtly now, but later `width` constraints should behave more predictably across elements.

quizDraft.title: Keep the inherited image inside its container
quizDraft.prompt:
## CSS task

The framed profile image can still become wider than a narrow container. A fluid maximum `width` prevents `overflow` while automatic `height` preserves the image's aspect ratio. Keep earlier CSS and add `max-width: 100%;` and `height: auto;` to an `img` rule. Resize the preview: the image should shrink with its container instead of forcing horizontal `overflow` or becoming distorted.

### File to edit

`styles.css`

### Check your work

Keep the site's existing cumulative work, make the requested change, then compare the **Preview** with the **Expected result** before moving on.
quizDraft.hint: Constrain `width` and let `height` follow the image's natural ratio.

help.concept: A fluid maximum `width` prevents `overflow` while automatic `height` preserves the image's aspect ratio.
help.hint_1: Constrain `width` and let `height` follow the image's natural ratio.
help.hint_2: Resize the preview: the image should shrink with its container instead of forcing horizontal `overflow` or becoming distorted.

quizDraft.title: Constrain the main content width
quizDraft.prompt:
## CSS task

On a wide viewport, long lines of content stretch farther than is comfortable to read. A flexible percentage `width` with a rem-based ceiling lets the layout adapt while keeping a readable upper bound. Keep all earlier styles and add `main { width: 90%; max-width: 64rem; }`. Widen and narrow the preview: main should scale with the viewport until it reaches the maximum `width`.

### File to edit

`styles.css`

### Check your work

Keep the site's existing cumulative work, make the requested change, then compare the **Preview** with the **Expected result** before moving on.
quizDraft.hint: Combine a fluid `width` with an upper limit instead of using one fixed `width`.

help.concept: A flexible percentage `width` with a rem-based ceiling lets the layout adapt while keeping a readable upper bound.
help.hint_1: Combine a fluid `width` with an upper limit instead of using one fixed `width`.
help.hint_2: Widen and narrow the preview: main should scale with the viewport until it reaches the maximum `width`.
